roles.title: Core Backend & Systems Engineer
roles.description: Architecting core backend infrastructure, low-level network components, lobby mechanics, and custom internal systems for OGXMC.
highlights: Engineered main OGX Core systems, lobby infrastructure, internal network pipelines, and a cross-network Punishment system
Forked and enhanced Limbo server implementation, adding a custom plugin extension engine to load lightweight modules alongside critical fixes and stability patches
Built low-level network routing, AFK handling systems, and high-performance server connection layers for smooth player flow

roles.title: Systems Architect & Java Backend Engineer
roles.description: Designing high-performance backend systems, proxy networks, and low-level software infrastructure for Minecraft server networks and private clients.
highlights: Built custom open-source libraries and distributed tools including ProxyGuard (defense-in-depth proxy security), Relayra (Redis messaging framework), and FluxEvents (runtime Bytecode event bus)
Architected multi-proxy network architectures using Velocity, Paper, and Docker containers for player authentication, connection filtering, and traffic routing
Delivered end-to-end backend logic, relational database schemas, and asynchronous input middleware for various production server setups
